structured.answer: The page says to open an account at Psagot ("פסגות") and buy "אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125 (4A)", ending with 86,045 ₪ after 10 years. That is for the page's own amounts (10,000 ₪ now and 500 ₪ a month), and a minus sign next to the fund worried me, so I would ask my son before doing anything.

stuck.where: Top of page, the buttons for choosing what to follow
stuck.why: English letters (MSCI World, S&P 500) at the very start; I almost left

stuck.where: The boxes for today's amount and the monthly amount
stuck.why: The numbers 10,000 and 500 were already filled in; I didn't know if they were mine, and I avoid sliders

stuck.where: Box for the next option with '-1,030 ₪', and the fund row with '-0.04%'
stuck.why: Minus signs made me think of losing money, like the fund that fell years ago

stuck.where: Cost breakdown: account 18 ₪ more, fund 1,390 ₪ less, tax 342 ₪ more
stuck.why: I couldn't tell what is more and what is less, or for whom

The chosen button 'ת"א-125' and the line about Israeli funds in shekels
The box marked 'הבחירה שלכם · הזול' with 86,045 ₪
The list of banks in order with their final amounts
The fund card 'אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125 (4A)', fees 0.1%

Notes saying 'לא בחישוב', a different price for soldiers or students
The list of all the funds following ת"א-125
skipped: The little arrows that open each row
unsure_meaning: MSCI World, MSCI AC World, S&P 500
מדד (I know it as the price index from the news)
The dotted purple lines under the numbers
The bar's colours, which look alike (orange and yellow)
not_found: Whether any of this is as safe as a deposit
A place clearly asking for my own amount, rather than a number already filled in
A plain sentence saying whether the fund can lose money
My own bank's full name and terms (I didn't open the rows)

findings.what: The page opens with English letters and words like מדד and קרן; someone like me feels it is not for her
The amounts are already filled in (10,000 and 500), so the big result isn't for my money, and nothing says so plainly
Minus signs next to the recommended fund and the second option are frightening and not explained
The company at the top (Psagot) is not a bank I know; the familiar banks come lower
Small grey text on a black background is hard to read
findings.where: All screens, especially the legend and 'הפס נחתך'

findings.what: 'בכסף של היום' and the inflation button aren't explained, so I don't know what the 86,045 ₪ means
The cost bar and its colours are hard to tell apart and to understand
A long list full of numbers and 'not in the calculation' notes is tiring
